question: Should this cross-domain retry consolidation merge once the remaining exact-head CI jobs complete successfully?
rationale: The patch has no identified defect, but it deliberately changes a shared availability primitive across gateway, channel, transcription, tunnel, and delivery paths and carries a protected maintainer label, so human ownership of the combined blast radius is required.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head jobs complete successfully and a maintainer confirms the shared supervisor preserves each caller’s retry contract.

options.title: Pause for narrower rollout
options.body: Keep the PR open and split the migrations by runtime domain if maintainers prefer independent rollout and rollback boundaries.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Merge after the remaining exact-head jobs complete successfully and a maintainer confirms the shared supervisor preserves each caller’s retry contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to recent gateway reconnect behavior and the linked consolidation initiative.
